description: Ministry of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports - Correction Notice of the ''Sports Law'' Gaz. Ex. Ordinary No. 2089/56 of 22.09.2018
reasoning: This gazette contains a correction to regulations under "The Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973," which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically amends procedural regulations for conducting elections within sports associations, falling under legal framework and regulatory modifications (Type 5). While a minister's name appears, it is in a signing capacity rather than detailing personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, so government classification types do not take precedence.
